data.name: Corporate Board
data.detailed_description:
The Sky-High Price of Success

Corporate Board is a high-stakes psychological thriller set in a near-future where the most valuable commodity isn’t data or oil—it’s sanity. You step into the bespoke Italian leather shoes of Kiran Deshmukh, a high-ranking executive at Cognitive Mirage Ltd. and a key figure in the enigmatic faction known as the Mindcrafters.

Classic Survival Horror Reborn

Corporate Board pays homage to the golden era of horror, blending the suffocating atmosphere of Silent Hill with the tense, investigative mystery of Resident Evil.

  • Psychological Dystopia: Experience a world where corporate greed has manifested into physical rot. The sterile glass and chrome of the upper floors melt into surreal, fleshy landscapes that reflect the twisted psyches of the Board Members.

  • Tactical Investigation: Resources are scarce. Manage your inventory of office supplies-turned-weapons and cryptic memos as you solve intricate environmental puzzles designed to keep the unworthy out.

  • The Board is Watching: Each floor is a gauntlet governed by the sins of a specific executive. Face grotesque manifestations of Avarice, Nepotism, and Cruelty—monsters that were once human, before the pursuit of profit stripped them of their souls.

Uncover the Truth

As Kiran, you aren't just fighting for your life; you’re fighting for the truth. Peel back layers of a massive conspiracy through deep lore found in discarded emails, hidden voice logs, and the environmental storytelling of a workplace turned into a slaughterhouse.

The Protagonist: Kiran Deshmukh

Kiran is the boardroom’s elegant and detached Cleaner, tasked with psychologically manipulating the company’s enemies. However, a routine hostile takeover reveals an impossible digital footprint, forcing Kiran to realize that Cognitive Mirage Ltd. is just a pawn in a far more lethal conspiracy.

data.short_description: As Kiran Deshmukh, survive a decaying monolith in this classic survival horror. Uncover the psychological rot of a corrupt mega-corp and the grisly crimes of its Board. In this dystopian thriller, the bottom line is written in blood. Profit is temporary. Pain is eternal.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i3-8100 / Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 750 Ti / RX 560 / Intel UHD 630
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-10400 / Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660 / RX 580 / RTX 2060
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Corporate Board features intense depictions of violence and gore, including graphic body horror and combat-related dismemberment. The narrative explores dark, mature themes inherent to a dystopian corporate landscape.
